name: Hotel & Restaurant Kaiserfels
beschreibung: Hotel & Restaurant Kaiserfels is set in St. Johann in Tirol, situated right on the slopes of the Kitzbühel Alps. Guests enjoy unbeatable ski-in/ski-out access to the St. Johann in Tirol / Oberndorf ski resort in winter, alongside direct connectivity to alpine hiking paths in summer. Amenities include an extensive wellness spa with an indoor pool, saunas, and fitness room, modern rooms, and a restaurant serving regional culinary treats.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel & Restaurant Kaiserfels in St. Johann in Tirol features 4-star ski-in/ski-out comfort, an indoor pool, a sauna wellness world, and fine Tyrolean dining.
